attribution.modifications: Original texture-free geometry on the BAG footprint: six saw-tooth bays with glazed north lights, the link under ivy, the chalet cafe front (black boards, scalloped bargeboards, half-timbered storey with blue shutters, yellow balcony band) and the brick wing, laid out from the 2019-2024 municipal panoramas; brick tones measured on them; graffiti drawn as generated tag pieces, not copied; no pixels or meshes imported.
